items.title: Tigers begin Asian Games camp, hope to get ‘adequate’ preparation
items.summary: Bangladesh began their Asian Games preparation camp on Sunday, returning to T20 cricket for the first time since their full series in Zimbabwe in July. With concerns over the facilities in Japan, adequate preparation is the priority as the Tigers prepare to depart for the tournament on September 24, ahead of their opening match in the quarterfinals on September 28.

items.title: In Pictures: Litton and Co begin practice ahead of Asian Games
items.summary: The team will play the quarterfinals directly on September 29, facing a side that advances from the first round.

items.title: Rishad, Aliss shine as Bangladesh 'A' clinch series in South Africa
items.summary: Rishad Hossain and Aliss Al Islam shared seven wickets before Saif Hassan and Mohammad Naim hit fifties as Bangladesh ‘A’ registered a five-wicket win over South Africa ‘A’ in the third and final one-dayer in Potchefstroom on Saturday, sealing the series 1-0.
